description: Calibration vs held-out subjects for the Phase 4 fusion engine (Dryad genuine walking only; Dryad has no spoofing).
source: results/metrics/phase2_splits.json (subject-level Phase 2 split) intersected with metadata hasMotion==TRUE and hasGNSS==TRUE

heldout_detail.note: Phase 2 validation subjects 3, 10, 11 were used to select Model A hyper-parameters. No fusion threshold has been computed from them. Only subject 12 is fully out-of-sample for Model A; Model A is comparison-only here.

unusable_subjects.0: no motion and/or no GNSS tracks (metadata hasMotion/hasGNSS)
unusable_subjects.1: no motion and/or no GNSS tracks (metadata hasMotion/hasGNSS)
unusable_subjects.2: no motion and/or no GNSS tracks (metadata hasMotion/hasGNSS)
unusable_subjects.9: no motion and/or no GNSS tracks (metadata hasMotion/hasGNSS)

rules: Thresholds, quantiles and persistence N are computed from calibration subjects only.
Held-out subjects are touched once, by evaluate.py, after thresholds.json is frozen and hashed.
Split written before any held-out evaluation quantity was computed.
